purpose: Where code may build its own S3/R2 client or spell R2 read-retry settings. Everything else reads R2 through these, so the ADR-0102 retry (a new connection and jittered backoff when a read breaks) is written once per language and every reader gets it. scripts/guard/r2-reads-have-one-path.sh refuses a client or setting outside them.

rust.areas_reason: Areas share no Cargo path dependency (root ADR-0001), so each area that talks to R2 has its own one place. foundation-platform's is foundation-outbox's R2 client and its read policy (r2/read_retry.rs). gongzzang's is the gongzzang-r2-object-storage crate: its client builder and its read with the same policy and numbers.

spark_reason: lakehouse_engine spells the Iceberg S3FileIO catalog settings and the s3a retry from the engine contract's r2_read; lakehouse_object_store applies the s3a settings. No other job spells a fs.s3a. or S3FileIO retry/HTTP-client key.
